decision: Stop KIOTA-CTOR-INDEX-TEST-1 after its bounded SUCCESS and select, without starting, SURVIVOR-THREAD-ONE-DETERMINISM-1. The exact test-only Kiota patch passed its focused two-test cell and all 155 current tests at the bound revision, so the remaining local frontier returns to the final one-thread operational survivor. Transfer intake remains blocked on independent external input; no external submission, current-defect claim or later experiment is authorized by this closure.

categories.assessment: The completed Kiota contribution converts a resolved public-input gap into a tested local asset. The sole executable local successor now asks the distinct source/evidence question of whether the one-thread survivor has any deterministic locally controllable witness; prospective transfer remains an intake gate rather than another search loop.

The Kiota exact pair, patch and raw test receipts are now preserved for human-gated upstream use. The unresolved internal asset is the final operational survivor and its scheduling, spawn, panic and stack boundaries; the transfer path still lacks a fresh independently curated package or functioning target.

The tested Kiota change remains a local draft requiring a fresh rebase, duplicate and maintainer-context preflight plus exact human approval before any submission. The selected survivor assessment is local-only and does not displace those external gates; transfer intake cannot contact or poll a provider while its input gate is absent.

Reuse the pinned mutation, source snapshot and historical dispatch evidence for the survivor assessment. Reuse the established transfer custody and target criteria only if an independent package or concrete functioning target is supplied; no new literature or data search is justified now.

The one-thread source/evidence assessment is bounded and locally feasible without its later deterministic-trigger gate, network or execution. Transfer intake has no useful local substitute for the missing independent input and separate authorization, so retaining it WAITING is evidence-bound rather than plan exhaustion.

candidates.rationale: This unchanged source/evidence-only assessment is the sole READY local item. It can delimit whether a deterministic operational witness is even designable before any separately authorized execution, and it preserves the existing zero-launch scope and one-hour cap.

No new independently curated custody/input package or concrete functioning target was supplied. The prior negative assessment remains controlling, and repeating design or search work would not remove that external prerequisite.

blockers.reason: A concrete owner-designated independent package or functioning target and separate metadata-only intake authorization are still absent.
